title: Renewal of the Mind by the Spirit
searchTerms: Renewal of the Mind by the Spirit
definition: Renewal of the mind by the Spirit is His work of reshaping the believer's thinking according to God's truth.
summary: The Spirit renews the mind so believers can discern and obey God's will.
christFocus: Jesus transforms His people by truth, and the Spirit applies that truth to the heart and mind.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit renews the mind by replacing lies with truth, worldly patterns with godly wisdom, and self-centered thinking with Christ-centered obedience.

This renewal happens through Scripture, prayer, repentance, worship, and daily dependence. It is ongoing transformation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people try to change behavior without addressing false thinking. This doctrine matters because transformation reaches the heart and mind.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your thoughts under Scripture. Ask the Spirit to expose lies, heal distorted thinking, and train you to think in ways that honor Christ.
